chunk_2.method: ContinueConv recovered 10/33→33/33, then polling 10 iter (7 TLS timeouts)

run1_old_code.observation: old code works but: no probe (TLS timeouts count as stale), no planner, polling max 10 iterations with hardcoded limit

events: stopped at 30, switched to pr pipeline
ticks.observation: same V1 violation as before — main conv does 30 tools before kernel cuts it off. not fixed yet.

events: SSE broke mid-stream (stop_reason empty), 272 bytes captured
poll 1: 272 bytes, probe → 200 (idle, accepted continue) ← PROBE WORKS
poll 4: 15394 bytes! (probe continue worked, content grew)
post-wait download also TLS timeout, using cached 121382 bytes
ticks.observation: 【关键】probe 生效了！poll 1 发现 272 bytes stale → probe → 200 → continue 被接受 → poll 4 涨到 15KB → poll 5 涨到 120KB。没有 probe 的话这个 chunk 会在 poll 5(stale=5) 就放弃重开新对话。但 71 分钟还是太长 — 主要是 TLS timeout 反复出现。

events: TLS timeout on first attempt, retry 1/6 after 1s → succeeded
ticks.observation: 正常模式：SSE 断了但 writeback + Continue 恢复了
正常。Axle verify_proof 多次触发（shadow skip）。theory 完成。

events: unit sizes: 2-10 files each, 4KB-163KB theory each
4 unclaimed files added to last unit
ticks.observation: 【核心改进】planner 8 秒就出结果。62 files 切成 12 units，大部分 2-5 files。比旧代码的 6 units（最大 82 files）好太多。但 unit 9 只有 1 file 却有 163KB theory — 可能是某个巨大的 .cu kernel 文件。

events: created 14+ files: headers, impls, Makefile, test
compile fix cycle: missing includes, Makefile fixes
tool_use_limit hit at 50 tools → Continue → more fixes
push to einsteinOS/dev-2 (multiple attempts, TLS issues)
ticks.observation: 【显著改善】unit 1 只有 5 files + 34KB prompt，20 分钟完成，compile=pass。上次 unit 1 也是 ~6 分钟，但上次 unit 2 (82 files) 花了 5+ 小时。这次 unit 2 只有 2 files。

events: fork d5e23cbe, prompt 36883 bytes, 2 files: expert_cache.hpp + expert_source.hpp
【验证】prompt 里是 conv 地址而不是全文
ticks.observation: unit 2 prompt = 36KB（包含 hw_info + unit 1 conv 地址 + 自己的 29KB theory）。上次 unit 2 prompt = 363KB。减少了 90%。

new_code_chunk1.note: probe saved it but TLS timeouts dragged out

planner.old_code: dev_split_theory static: 6 units, max 82 files/unit, max 425KB theory/unit
planner.new_code: dev_plan planner conv: 12 units, max 10 files/unit, max 163KB theory/unit (most ≤40KB)

dev_unit_prompt_size.old_code_unit2: 363KB (82 files theory + prior conv full text)

dev_unit_1.new_code: 20min, 110 tools, compile=pass (more thorough — found corex, made stubs, ran tests)

issues_remaining.issue: chunk 1 polling took 71 min with new code (vs 32 min old code)
issues_remaining.cause: probe sends continue → remote accepts → but TLS timeouts prevent downloading the result for several polls. probe is working but the download path is unreliable.
issues_remaining.fix_suggestion: probe 返回 200 时就意味着远程接受了 continue 且在跑，但下载内容需要另一条 HTTP 路径。也许 probe 成功后应该等更久再下载（5min instead of 3min），或者用 download-file 直接拿 create_file 产出而不是 DownloadConv 全文

issues_remaining.cause: planner 把某个巨大 kernel 文件单独分出来了。theory 本身就很大。
issues_remaining.fix_suggestion: 不需要修 — 1 file 的 unit 子对话 context 压力不大，163KB theory 能装下

issues_remaining.issue: main conv still does 30 tool_use before kernel cuts it off
issues_remaining.fix_suggestion: 老问题，不影响 pipeline。主对话第一条消息应该直接 pr_pipeline 不给 tool call 机会

what_works: W1: ProbeConvBusy 救了 chunk 1 — 272 bytes stale → probe continue → 120KB
W2: dev_planner 8 秒出结果，62 files → 12 units，大部分 ≤5 files
W3: conv 地址传递生效 — unit 2 prompt 37KB vs 旧代码 363KB（-90%）
W4: unit 1 compile=pass，子对话自己找到 corex clang，创建 stubs，修 Makefile
W5: ContinueConv 在 chunk 2 和 chunk 3 都正常恢复了缺失文件
